ablations.configuration_chain: run DirectedCutOnly on the fixed 45-query panel; reuse matching production Base/Enhanced records
ablations.endpoint_floor: build in an isolated git archive with exactly one registered expression changed from max(farthest, endpoint-floor) to farthest, pass all CTest, then run Base and Enhanced on the fixed 45-query panel
ablations.stop_on: any completed objective/feasibility mismatch or any build diff outside the registered expression

enhanced_hard_stop.rule: after the first real 10000-second Enhanced timeout is durably recorded, run_experiments exits 4; the parent stops launching work, terminates the other process group, records the anomaly, and ends the campaign

requirements: current task-key set exactly equals the archived 8318 queries times three methods
current task keys and query path match

likely_timeout_stop.action: do not start q6--q10 at that g or any query at larger g for that graph/method
likely_timeout_stop.evidence: for one fixed graph, g and method, all preregistered tranche-1 q1--q5 (one from each realized-group-size stratum) reach the real 10000-second limit and Enhanced solves all five
likely_timeout_stop.reporting: never count these records as formal timeout, solved, elapsed time, PAR-2 input, or a completed matrix cell; retain task keys and five timeout evidence keys so they can be rerun later
likely_timeout_stop.why_no_S2_extrapolation: runtime need not be monotone in target f, so the controlled grid is run in full

ordering.P2_Enhanced_estimate: old five-query Enhanced cell time scaled to ten queries
ordering.S2_Enhanced_estimate: old preregistered q3 Enhanced time scaled to five queries
ordering.fallback: deterministic graph-size times subset-count score, used only if a historical estimate is absent
ordering.scientific_effect: none; ordering changes neither solver, timeout nor reporting

paper_scope: P1/P2/S2 main matrix plus the separately preregistered minimal ablations
phase_order: validate binary/matrix/input identities and historical reuse
run every remaining P2 and all S2 Enhanced cell, ordered by read-only historical estimates from fast to slow
run P2 Base and PrunedDP++ in ascending g frontiers, with estimated fast-to-slow order inside each g
run all S2 Base and PrunedDP++ cells from fast to slow without cross-f extrapolation
run the two preregistered minimal ablation panels
